messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for service `inference-east-ml` (P1) — high tail latency detected (>99th percentile > 4s)

pagerduty: Incident #PD-3421 assigned to group `infra-oncall` — escalation to user sam in 3m if not acknowledged

sam: acked — taking it

maria: thx. sam can you confirm customer impact? any 5xxs or just latency?

sam: looks like mostly latency. spikes on long-generation routes (/v1/generate) — 500ms -> 4-6s for a subset of requests. no new 5xxs in the last minute.

lee: seeing increased queue depth on the east batcher nodes (east-batcher-*) — backlog of ~1200 requests, normal ~100-200.

dana: behavior matches queuing + slow downstream KV cache hits. KV miss rate jumped from 2% -> 18% in the last 5m.

sam: ok taking point. starting triage: 1) isolate whether batching params changed 2) check autoscaler for stuck nodes 3) inspect redis/kv latency

maria: @sam if you need to re-route traffic, use routing policy `safe-fallback` to route to `inference-east-standby` (lower throughput but stable).

sam: running quick query against metrics:

```
# prometheus
sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate",le="4.0"}[1m])) by (instance)
```

sam: confirming one instance east-rt-03 shows p95 ~ 5.8s and very high goroutine count. CPU at 98%.

ops-rotation: FYI i'm watching for any customer pages (cc @maria)

maria: customer impact note: a subset of customers in EU/US-east sending longer prompts will see degraded response times; embed/short payload routes seem fine. tagging a few customers: cb-partnerA, retail-beta.

sam: trying hot-restart of east-rt-03 now (rolling restart via k8s rollout restart deployment/rt-east-03)

pagerduty: Reminder: PD escalation timer will re-escalate to `infra-senior` in 4m unless resolved/acked by others.

sam: restart triggered. tailing logs:

```
2026-03-14T15:02:11Z east-rt-03 inference-serving[pid=4321]: kv-client: read latency 1120ms for key prefix "cache:kv:prefix"
2026-03-14T15:02:12Z east-rt-03 inference-serving[pid=4321]: runtime: GC pause 120ms, goroutines 427
2026-03-14T15:02:14Z east-rt-03 inference-serving[pid=4321]: batching: queue depth 980 -> processing
```

sam: restart succeeded. CPU dropping. p95 back to ~1.2s on that instance. queue draining.

dana: KV miss rate still elevated but reduce to 7% — maybe cache warmup during restart.

lee: autoscaler shows we didn't get new node spin up because node pool limits hit max for east region (quota).

maria: can we temporarily enable `burst-capacity` to allow additional pods? ops-rotation can we lift pool cap for 10m?

ops-rotation: I can request quota bump but that takes longer. Alternative: enable `burst-capacity` flag for the dedicated pool — toggling now.

sam: toggled burst-capacity, scheduler started 3 new pods (east-rt-burst-01..03). p95 across cluster now 600-800ms.

pagerduty: @sam acknowledged and active — PD escalation timer reset.

maria: good mitigation. next steps: 1) monitor for 15m 2) collect heap/pprof from east-rt-03 and one of the burst nodes 3) start a short customer comms draft if we see recurrence

sam: collecting profiles and will attach to incident ticket PD-3421. grabbing heap profile now.

lee: quick note — found a recent config change in the autoscaler thresholds merged 2 hours ago (change #PR-4591) that reduced headroom for short spikes. might be related.

dana: also saw a rolling kernel update on node image east-nodepool-2 last night — might've reduced throughput margins. adding to timeline.

maria: assigning follow-ups: sam (oncall) — full triage + logs/profiles; lee — autoscaler PR rollback or tune; dana — KV team investigation; ops-rotation — document temporary burst toggle and revert plan.

sam: will update status in 10m. current status: mitigated (traffic rebalanced + extra pods). customer impact: degraded latency for ~12% of long gen requests for ~22m window.

pagerduty: @sam — please update incident status in PD when you have the ticket link

sam: PD-3421 link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-3421 — added notes, attaching profiles.

maria: :white_check_mark: thanks. once we stabilize for 30m we can close the PD and open a postmortem.

sam: agreed. moving to monitoring. I'll ping here if anything changes.

ops-rotation: leaving the burst-capacity enabled for 30m then will revert per runbook.

lee: filing PR to revert autoscaler threshold change now — will request quick review from infra-senior.

sam: closing loop — final customer impact summary will be in the postmortem.

dana: noted. thanks team. :heart:

incident-bot: Incident PD-3421 status: mitigated — acknowledged by sam, assigned to infra-oncall, follow-ups created. Status channel will be updated if status changes.
